# WJ98 · Logs

Group **WJ · Quản trị agent (Next.js)** · page · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/admin/logs`) · account `owner`

## Purpose
System log read from file (system log tab) and the audit log of staff actions (second tab).

## Agent and care context
- Audit entries record field names, roles and ids, not names, emails or passwords. File logging can be switched off on the server; the page then says "Ghi log ra file đang tắt".

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `owner` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `admin.logs`.
- Roles that can open the page: owner, manager.
- Menu entry: "Logs" in the section "Quản trị agent", shown when the role holds any of `admin.logs`.

## Key actions
- Tabs "Log hệ thống" | "Nhật ký thao tác"
- Level and scope selects, search, "Tải lại"
- "Chi tiết" / "Thu gọn" on a row; "Xem thêm 150 dòng cũ hơn"

## Related screens
States, dialogs and tabs of this page:
- [WJ99](WJ99.md) · Logs · Nhật ký thao tác (tab)
- [WJ100](WJ100.md) · Logs · ghi log ra file đang tắt (state)
- [WJ101](WJ101.md) · Logs · không có dòng log (state)

## Logic source
- Source: `pema-agent/frontend/src/app/(admin)/admin/logs/page.tsx`
- Source: `pema-agent/frontend/src/components/admin/logs/audit-log-table.tsx`
- Source: `pema-agent/frontend/src/components/admin/logs/log-row.tsx`
- No tests.
- Agent administration ported from the zalo-agent dashboard (its SECTIONS array, see PORT-MAP.md): the Next.js pages keep that information architecture and use the Pema shell, tokens and `src/ui` kit. Menu section "Quản trị agent" of `src/lib/nav.tsx`.
- Reached against the mock BE (`pnpm dev:mock`): `mock/auth.ts` simulates the role to permission table of ARCH-PB01; the real back end decides and every request is authorised there (deny by default). The menu only hides entries.
- How to reach it (mock BE, `pnpm dev:mock`): sign in as the mock account `owner` → open `/admin/logs`; it must show "Logs".

## Responsive
- 1440×900 is the reference (Frame, Layout).
- 1920×1020: no layout change
- 1280×720: no layout change
- 1024×768: no layout change
- 390×844: aside: position static → fixed; aside: width 232 → 288px · hidden: "Không gian phòng khám", "/" · new: "Việc", "Hồ sơ", "Inbox", "Duyệt", "Chờ tôi", "Menu"
- Overflow per viewport from the screenshots: `pema-agent/frontend/visual-ref/old/manifest.json` (W1), when present.

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- Logs
- Log toàn hệ thống đọc từ file. File ghi cả mức debug nên đầy đủ hơn nhìn terminal.
- Loại nhật ký
- Log hệ thống
- Nhật ký thao tác
- Mọi mức
- Debug trở lên
- Info trở lên
- Warn trở lên
- Chỉ Error
- Mọi scope
- Tìm trong log rồi Enter...
- Tải lại
- Đang tải...
- Chi tiết
- Thu gọn
- Xem thêm 150 dòng cũ hơn
- Đã hết log lưu lại. Log cũ hơn bị xoay vòng theo thời hạn lưu của máy chủ.

## Business rules
- Patient safety is a policy profile, never a removed feature: `patient_channel` (the default: messages to patients go to the review queue and a person sends them; memory from patient content is off; image, video, document and web tools are off; a red flag goes to a doctor before any model call; personal data is masked before the model; identity of a Zalo user is confirmed before the assistant names a patient) and `staff_assistant` (internal, staff-only accounts). The profile is set per Zalo account and per agent, the stricter of the two applies (PLAN-AI01 section 5).

## Differences from the app design
